protocol: step6_feature_ablation (mechanistic contribution experiment; Step 4 remains the formal frozen zero-shot result, Step 5 the temporal-purge robustness result)

training.normalization: SCS_CHANNEL_MEAN/STD (SCS train 2003-2010 only, frozen in src/configs/config.py), subset per model to retained channels in dataset order
training.note: the deployed FULL_FROZEN checkpoint was trained on the pre-causal v9 file; all four Step-6 models (incl. FULL) are trained on causal v2 for strict comparability; FULL_FROZEN is an external anchor only

evaluation.population: Step-4 common (t,i,j) indices from step2_persistence_v2/persistence_raw_predictions.npz — identical samples/masks for all models and baselines
evaluation.tau: 0.8 / 0.9 pinned a priori; sweep diagnostic only

terminology: cumulative HotSpot channels are legitimate thermal-stress predictors (NOAA CRW DHW = 12-week accumulation of HotSpot>=1C); attribution experiment, NOT a leakage/shortcut claim
